strings.ui.opengl_is_recommended_directx_11_is_a: OpenGL is recommended. DirectX 11 is available on Windows. Vulkan is optional. Software is the compatibility fallback.
strings.ui.match_window_follows_the_window_size_: Match window follows the window size. Fixed resolutions render at that size and scale to fit the window; they do not change internal CEL resolution.
strings.ui.the_3do_outputs_60_fields_per_second_: The 3DO outputs 60 fields per second (50 for PAL). Rates above 60 re-present the latest frame; they do not create extra motion.
strings.ui.auto_only_drops_presentation_frames_w: Auto only drops presentation frames when the loop misses its deadline. The game still runs at full speed, so input, audio, and save states are unchanged.
strings.ui.also_save_the_native_cpu_frame_with_s: Also save the native CPU frame with screenshots
strings.ui.xbr_runs_an_edge_directed_4x_pass_hqx: xBR runs an edge-directed 4x pass; HQx runs a 2x/3x/4x CPU pixel-art pass; FSR runs AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 (EASU + RCAS) at the output. CRT bloom adds a glow around bright areas. All of them cost more CPU/GPU time at 4K; HQx 3x/4x are the most expensive.
strings.ui.enable_the_in_game_quick_menu_f4_or_s: Enable the in-game quick menu (F4 or Select+Start)
strings.ui.notifications_confirm_save_load_rewin: Notifications confirm save/load, rewind, fast-forward, screenshots, resets, and settings changes. The quick menu pauses the game while it is open and resumes when it closes.
strings.ui.the_crop_is_presentation_only_per_gam: The crop is presentation-only. Per-game profiles can store their own crop; the border and void color are global.
strings.ui.field_handling_is_presentation_only_a: Field handling is presentation-only. Auto leaves 240p output byte-identical to Bob; explicit modes are useful for titles that flicker or comb. Weave produces a 480-line frame with half-height rows.
strings.ui.run_ahead_saves_and_restores_state_ev: Run-ahead saves and restores state every displayed frame; rewind recording and deterministic movies are paused while it is active. Frame delay intentionally adds latency. The FPS overlay reports the software input-poll-to-frame-submit time.

strings.ui.device_and_buffer_changes_restart_ope: Device and buffer changes restart OpenAL output without resetting the machine.
strings.ui.the_audio_sync_offset_is_applied_when: The audio sync offset is applied when OpenAL output is created or reset. A positive value adds the same fixed delay to every sample; it does not change emulation speed or state.

strings.ui.tip.custom_width_height_ratio_for_exa: Custom width/height ratio, for example 1.333 or 1.6.
strings.ui.tip.restrict_scaling_to_whole_number_: Restrict scaling to whole-number multiples for uniform pixels.
strings.ui.tip.request_vertical_sync_from_the_pl: Request vertical sync from the platform where the backend supports it.
strings.ui.tip.refresh_rate_used_to_present_the_: Refresh rate used to present the latest emulated frame.
strings.ui.tip.60_hz_keeps_render_on_demand_high: 60 Hz keeps render-on-demand. Higher rates re-present the latest frame more often for lower latency. The game still runs at normal speed.
strings.ui.tip.presentation_only_emulation_speed: Presentation-only. Emulation speed, audio, and save states are unchanged.
strings.ui.tip.skip_presentation_frames_when_the: Skip presentation frames when the emulator falls behind. Emulation and audio keep full speed.
strings.ui.tip.auto_is_recommended_fixed_modes_p: Auto is recommended. Fixed modes present one of every 2-5 frames; emulation still runs every frame.
strings.ui.tip.show_frame_rate_renderer_timing_a: Show frame rate, renderer timing, and audio queue counters over the game.
strings.ui.tip.write_a_second_unfiltered_png_of_: Write a second, unfiltered PNG of the native CPU frame beside the filtered capture.
strings.ui.tip.adjust_the_glow_around_bright_are: Adjust the glow around bright areas in the CRT filter.
strings.ui.tip.adjust_rcas_sharpening_when_the_f: Adjust RCAS sharpening when the FSR filter is selected.
strings.ui.tip.filter_notes_xbr_and_hqx_are_cpu_: Filter notes: xBR and HQx are CPU-heavy; FSR and CRT bloom run on the GPU.

strings.ui.tip.choose_controller_port_1_6_for_th: Choose controller port 1-6 for the input display.
strings.ui.tip.hide_outer_pixels_from_each_edge_: Hide outer pixels from each edge without changing emulation.
strings.ui.tip.detect_blank_borders_and_crop_the: Detect blank borders and crop them with a one-second hysteresis. A manual crop above or a per-game crop overrides it.
strings.ui.tip.draw_a_border_outside_the_present: Draw a border outside the presented image.
strings.ui.tip.void_area_and_border_color_as_rrg: Void-area and border color as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
strings.ui.tip.void_area_pattern_solid_checkerbo: Void-area pattern: solid, checkerboard, grid, or scanlines. The pattern is presentation-only and is shared by every renderer.
strings.ui.tip.crop_values_do_not_affect_frame_h: Crop values do not affect frame hashes, input, audio, or save states.
strings.ui.tip.choose_how_the_two_fields_of_an_i: Choose how the two fields of an interlaced title are combined.
strings.ui.tip.auto_detects_480i_fields_and_weav: Auto detects 480i fields and weaves them. Bob presents every field unchanged. Weave always combines two fields into 480 lines. Blend averages them into one flicker-free frame.
strings.ui.tip.does_not_change_emulated_state_in: Does not change emulated state, input, audio, frame hashes, or save states.
strings.ui.tip.ask_github_s_public_release_feed_: Ask GitHub's public release feed whether a newer 5DO version exists. Only the release URL is requested; no personal data is sent.
strings.ui.tip.run_ahead_presentation_delay_adap: Run-ahead, presentation delay, adaptive sync, and the software input-to-present measurement.
strings.ui.tip.run_0_1_or_2_speculative_frames_a: Run 0, 1, or 2 speculative frames ahead of presentation to reduce input latency.
strings.ui.tip.zero_is_the_safe_default_run_ahea: Zero is the safe default. Run-ahead costs one extra emulated frame per step and is incompatible with rewind and deterministic movie recording.
strings.ui.tip.hold_the_presented_image_this_man: Hold the presented image this many frames behind the core.
strings.ui.tip.zero_is_the_lowest_latency_path_p: Zero is the lowest-latency path. Positive values are useful for matching a high-latency audio path or inspecting frames; they increase input-to-photon latency.
strings.ui.tip.disable_the_blocking_swap_interva: Disable the blocking swap interval and present through the compositor so the GPU driver and monitor can drive adaptive sync. The display, driver, and desktop must already support VRR.
strings.ui.tip.these_options_are_presentation_la: These options are presentation/latency controls. They do not change the emulated frame hashes, save-state format, or disc timing; frame delay changes what the host shows.
strings.ui.tip.this_is_the_portion_of_input_to_p: This is the portion of input-to-photon latency inside 5DO. Display scanout and pixel response require an external photodiode measurement.
strings.ui.tip.openal_output_volume_cd_da_mix_an: OpenAL output, volume, CD-DA mix, and test-tone settings.
strings.ui.tip.enable_or_disable_live_openal_pla: Enable or disable live OpenAL playback.
strings.ui.tip.play_the_emulated_dsp_through_the: Play the emulated DSP through the bundled OpenAL Soft runtime.
strings.ui.tip.set_the_red_book_cd_audio_mix_lev: Set the Red Book CD audio mix level.
strings.ui.tip.keep_cd_da_playback_running_witho: Keep CD-DA playback running without mixing it into the output.
strings.ui.tip.ode_style_automatic_disc_advance_: ODE-style automatic disc advance after a guest eject. When no playlist is loaded, use F3 to insert a disc.
strings.ui.tip.play_a_one_second_440_hz_tone_to_: Play a one-second 440 Hz tone to verify the output device.
strings.ui.tip.default_uses_the_openal_soft_defa: Default uses the OpenAL Soft default. Selecting a named device switches output immediately.
strings.ui.tip.target_openal_queue_latency_lower: Target OpenAL queue latency. Lower values reduce delay; higher values resist crackle.
strings.ui.tip.the_emulated_machine_keeps_runnin: The emulated machine keeps running; only the host audio queue is recreated.
strings.ui.tip.shift_audio_relative_to_video_pos: Shift audio relative to video. Positive values delay audio; negative values advance it.
strings.ui.tip.offset_from_250_to_250_millisecon: Offset from -250 to 250 milliseconds. Positive values insert silence and delay audio; negative values drop the first samples and advance it.
strings.ui.tip.current_audio_sync_offset_in_mill: Current audio sync offset in milliseconds.
strings.ui.tip.use_the_fps_overlay_to_compare_th: Use the FPS overlay to compare the reported audio latency with the video frame delay.
strings.ui.tip.audio_backend_status_and_test_ton: Audio backend status and test-tone result.
strings.ui.tip.per_game_fixes_arm_clio_cel_and_c: Per-game fixes, ARM, CLIO, CEL, and CD timing, CD speed, CPU clock, random seed, Opera DIPIR/soft reset, NVRAM storage, high-resolution mode, rewind/fast-forward, and overrides.
strings.ui.tip.apply_the_compatibility_fix_mask_: Apply the compatibility fix mask from the built-in game database when a disc opens.
strings.ui.tip.render_cels_and_bitmap_lines_at_6: Render CELs and bitmap lines at 640x480. Only enable for titles that support it.
strings.ui.tip.select_the_arm60_n_cycle_length_u: Select the ARM60 N-cycle length used by the interpreter.
strings.ui.tip.freedo_compatible_uses_n_4_arm60_: FreeDO-compatible uses N=4. ARM60 datasheet uses N=2 and changes instruction timing; save states record the mode.
strings.ui.tip.select_how_the_clio_timer_slots_a: Select how the CLIO timer slots are scanned.
strings.ui.tip.freedo_services_all_timers_per_ev: FreeDO services all timers per event. Opera walks one timer slot at a time with an explicit cascade carry; save states record the mode.
strings.ui.tip.select_how_the_madam_cel_engine_c: Select how the MADAM CEL engine consumes emulated time.
strings.ui.tip.freedo_draws_synchronously_opera_: FreeDO draws synchronously. Opera defers the draw and keeps CEL status busy until the estimated pixel/texel deadline; save states record the mode.
strings.ui.tip.select_how_the_cd_rom_drive_sched: Select how the CD-ROM drive schedules data sectors.
strings.ui.tip.freedo_transfers_sectors_immediat: FreeDO transfers sectors immediately. Opera schedules each sector at the stock 2x drive speed and reports the drive busy while it is not ready; save states record the mode.
strings.ui.tip.arm60_clock_multiplier_1_0_is_the: ARM60 clock multiplier. 1.0 is the stock 12.5 MHz; 0.5x-4x is supported.
strings.ui.tip.enter_a_multiplier_between_0_5_an: Enter a multiplier between 0.5 and 4.0. Higher clocks can change timing-sensitive behavior.
strings.ui.tip.initial_dsp_prng_seed_leave_blank: Initial DSP PRNG seed. Leave blank for the FreeDO default, or enter a 32-bit value.
strings.ui.tip.a_fixed_seed_makes_fresh_runs_rep: A fixed seed makes fresh runs reproducible. The seed is part of save-state data once the DSP advances.
strings.ui.tip.the_disc_whose_per_game_overrides: The disc whose per-game overrides are being edited.
strings.ui.tip.the_currently_loaded_game_and_its: The currently loaded game and its database entry.
strings.ui.tip.override_the_automatic_4do_compat: Override the automatic 4DO compatibility fix mask.
strings.ui.tip.enter_a_hexadecimal_fix_mask_or_l: Enter a hexadecimal fix mask, or leave blank to use the database value.
strings.ui.tip.a_blank_override_keeps_the_automa: A blank override keeps the automatic per-game fix mask.
strings.ui.tip.override_the_output_filter_for_th: Override the output filter for this game.
strings.ui.tip.automatic_or_a_per_game_filter_ov: Automatic or a per-game filter override.
strings.ui.tip.effective_read_speed_for_the_cycl: Effective read speed for the cycle-based CD model.
strings.ui.tip.stock_is_2x_unbounded_removes_the: Stock is 2x. Unbounded removes the host-side sector delay; speeds above 16x can expose timing issues.
strings.ui.tip.apply_a_named_bundle_of_timing_op: Apply a named bundle of timing options.
strings.ui.tip.compatible_keeps_freedo_timing_ac: Compatible keeps FreeDO timing. Accuracy enables ARM60, Opera timers, CEL busy timing, and cycle-based CD reads. Performance uses a 1.5x CPU clock with FreeDO timing. Custom keeps the current options.
strings.ui.tip.override_automatic_bios_selection: Override automatic BIOS selection for the current game.
strings.ui.tip.automatic_uses_the_region_appropr: Automatic uses the region-appropriate BIOS from the BIOS folder. A specific image pins this game to that BIOS MD5.
strings.ui.tip.choose_one_shared_nvram_image_or_: Choose one shared NVRAM image or a separate image for every game.
strings.ui.tip.per_game_keeps_each_title_s_save_: Per-game keeps each title's save data isolated. Switching from shared copies the shared image on the first save.
strings.ui.tip.versions_0_9_are_separate_images_: Versions 0-9 are separate images. Changing the version does not overwrite another version.
strings.ui.tip.keep_compressed_keyframes_and_inp: Keep compressed keyframes and input so the emulated machine can be rewound.
strings.ui.tip.rewind_window_in_seconds_longer_w: Rewind window in seconds. Longer windows use more memory.
strings.ui.tip.history_length_in_seconds_the_def: History length in seconds. The default is 60 seconds.
strings.ui.tip.multiplier_used_while_the_fast_fo: Multiplier used while the fast-forward hotkey is held.
strings.ui.tip.run_2x_10x_emulated_frames_per_pr: Run 2x-10x emulated frames per presentation tick. Audio is muted while fast-forwarding.
strings.ui.tip.choose_the_pbus_device_on_ports_1: Choose the PBUS device on ports 1-3.
strings.ui.tip.port_1_device_a_joypad_is_the_def: Port 1 device. A joypad is the default; mouse, lightgun, arcade lightgun, flightstick, and Orbatak trackball are available.
strings.ui.tip.choose_the_pbus_device_on_ports_4: Choose the PBUS device on ports 4-6.
strings.ui.tip.ntsc_320x240_at_60_hz_pal1_320x28: NTSC 320x240 at 60 Hz, PAL1 320x288 at 50 Hz, or PAL2 384x288 at 50 Hz.
strings.ui.tip.pal_requires_a_pal_bios_region_ch: PAL requires a PAL BIOS. Region changes take effect the next time the machine is created.
strings.ui.tip.the_machine_applies_the_region_wh: The machine applies the region when it boots; restart emulation after changing it.
strings.ui.tip.when_enabled_a_pal_bios_selects_p: When enabled, a PAL BIOS selects PAL1 and an NTSC BIOS selects NTSC. Disable to force the Video region selection.
strings.ui.tip.pin_this_game_to_ntsc_pal1_or_pal: Pin this game to NTSC, PAL1, or PAL2 regardless of the automatic/global choice.
strings.ui.tip.automatic_follows_the_bios_global: Automatic follows the BIOS/global region. A specific region applies whenever this disc opens.
strings.ui.tip.choose_which_controller_port_rece: Choose which controller port receives the host mouse/lightgun pointer.
strings.ui.tip.all_sends_one_pointer_to_every_po: All sends one pointer to every pointer device. Selecting a port gives each player an independent aim point.
strings.ui.tip.store_the_six_device_choices_as_a: Store the six device choices as a per-game override. Unchecked edits the global device list.
strings.ui.tip.save_delete_import_or_export_the_: Save, delete, import, or export the timing/CD-DA profile for the current game.
strings.ui.tip.store_the_timing_and_cd_da_option: Store the timing and CD-DA options as this game's profile.
strings.ui.tip.load_a_profile_json_file_and_appl: Load a profile JSON file and apply it to this game.
strings.ui.tip.save_this_game_s_profile_as_json: Save this game's profile as JSON.
strings.ui.tip.whether_this_game_has_a_stored_pr: Whether this game has a stored profile.
strings.ui.tip.dram_vram_capacity_reported_to_th: DRAM/VRAM capacity reported to the BIOS through MADAM RED SYSBITS.
strings.ui.tip.stock_is_2_mb_dram_1_mb_vram_expa: Stock is 2 MB DRAM / 1 MB VRAM. Expanded layouts change the RAM boundary and VRAM base; changing it restarts the machine.
strings.ui.tip.enable_clio_dipir_latches_and_xbu: Enable CLIO DIPIR latches and XBUS access aborts. Save states record the setting and warn on a mismatch; changing it restarts the machine.
strings.ui.tip.use_opera_s_arm_madam_dsp_reset_s: Use Opera's ARM/MADAM/DSP reset sequence for CLIO CSTAT soft resets. Save states record the setting and warn on a mismatch; changing it restarts the machine.
strings.ui.tip.choose_the_pbus_device_on_ports_7: Choose the PBUS device on ports 7-8. The Opera daisy chain supports eight devices; the legacy 4DO packet carries six.
strings.ui.tip.opera_s_opera_active_devices_cap_: Opera's opera_active_devices cap: 0 reports no devices, 8 allows every port.
strings.ui.tip.caps_how_many_configured_pbus_por: Caps how many configured PBUS ports are polled. One can work around titles that misbehave with multiple controllers.
strings.ui.tip.hide_the_desktop_crosshair_while_: Hide the desktop crosshair while the emulated lightgun still receives the pointer. Useful when the game draws its own reticle or when recording.
strings.ui.tip.handle_portfolio_os_fixed_point_m: Handle Portfolio OS fixed-point math SWIs on the host. This mirrors Opera's opera_swi_hle option, is disabled by default, and restarts the machine when changed.
strings.ui.tip.pause_emulation_when_the_desktop_: Pause emulation when the desktop window is deactivated and resume it when focus returns. Held keyboard and pad input is released either way.
